blocks.en: The fact that a compact operator is ``more than'' continuous motivated the use of the term \emph{completely continuous} operator for a compact operator. This terminology was common years ago but is used less frequently today.
blocks.zh: 紧算子 ``不只是'' 连续的这一事实, 促使人们用\emph{完全连续}算子这一术语来指紧算子. 这一术语多年前很常见, 但如今已较少使用.

blocks.en: The connection between compact operators and the dimension of the domain and range of the operator is even closer than Lemma~\ref{lem:infinite-dimensional-identity-noncompact} suggests.
blocks.zh: 紧算子与其定义域和值域的维数之间的联系, 比 Lemma~\ref{lem:infinite-dimensional-identity-noncompact} 所暗示的还要紧密.

blocks.en: Let $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ be a linear operator from $X$ to $Y$. Then we have the following:\begin{enumerate}\item If $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is bounded and the range $\mathcal{R}(A)$ is finite-dimensional, then the operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is compact.\item If the domain $\mathcal{D}(A)$ is finite-dimensional, then the operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is compact.\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: 设 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 为从 $X$ 到 $Y$ 的线性算子. 那么有以下结论:\begin{enumerate}\item 若 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 有界且值域 $\mathcal{R}(A)$ 有限维, 则算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 为紧算子.\item 若定义域 $\mathcal{D}(A)$ 有限维, 则算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 为紧算子.\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: thm:finite-dimensional-domain-range-compactness

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
For part 1, let $x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$ be a given bounded sequence. Since the operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is bounded, the sequence $A(x_n)\in\mathcal{R}(A)$ is also bounded. Since $\mathcal{R}(A)$ is finite-dimensional, the Bolzano-Weierstrass theorem implies that $A(x_n)$ has a convergent subsequence. Thus, $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is compact.

For part 2, we note that the dimension of the range of an operator is less than or equal to the dimension of the domain. (If $\{x_i\}_{i=1}^k$ is a basis for $\mathcal{D}(A)$, then $\{A(x_i)\}_{i=1}^k$ spans $\mathcal{R}(A)$.) Also, by Lemma~\ref{lem:finite-dimensional-domain-operators-bounded}, any operator with a finite-dimensional domain is bounded. Thus, we can use part 1 to complete the proof.
blocks.zh:
对于第 1 部分, 给定有界序列 $x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$. 由于算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 有界, 序列 $A(x_n)\in\mathcal{R}(A)$ 也有界. 由于 $\mathcal{R}(A)$ 有限维, Bolzano-Weierstrass 定理表明 $A(x_n)$ 有收敛子序列. 因而 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 为紧算子.

对于第 2 部分, 注意算子值域的维数小于或等于定义域的维数. (若 $\{x_i\}_{i=1}^k$ 为 $\mathcal{D}(A)$ 的一组基, 则 $\{A(x_i)\}_{i=1}^k$ 张成 $\mathcal{R}(A)$.) 而且由 Lemma~\ref{lem:finite-dimensional-domain-operators-bounded}, 任何定义域有限维的算子都有界. 因而利用第 1 部分即可完成证明.

blocks.en: If $A\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ and $\mathcal{R}(A)$ is finite-dimensional, we say the operator $A$ has \textbf{finite rank}.
blocks.zh: 若 $A\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ 且 $\mathcal{R}(A)$ 有限维, 则称算子 $A$ 具有\textbf{有限秩}.
blocks.label: def:finite-rank-operator

blocks.en: One common way of proving an operator is compact is by approximating by other operators (such as operators of finite rank) which are known to be compact. In using such an approximation scheme one usually employs the following result.
blocks.zh: 证明算子紧性的一种常用方法是, 用已知为紧算子的其他算子 (例如有限秩算子) 来逼近它. 使用这种逼近方法时, 通常要用到以下结果.

blocks.en: Let $A_n\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ be a sequence of compact operators. Suppose $A_n$ converges in the operator norm to an operator $A$. Then $A$ is compact.
blocks.zh: 设 $A_n\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ 为紧算子序列. 假设 $A_n$ 在算子范数下收敛到算子 $A$. 那么 $A$ 为紧算子.
